'''Vanguard Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operating under the control of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstitued Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the death of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], the station was taken over by a group of Imperial defectors led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Korven]] as their base of operations. They began targeting and destroying nearby Alliance outposts, which eventually prompted the Alliance to [[Battle of Vanguard Station|retaliate]] and wipe out the defectors threatening them.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vanguard Station appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the setting for the "Fractured" Uprising.
